characters.name: Lingo
characters.description: The titular character of the show, the ringmaster of the Big Bug Stage. He is in charge of bringing him and his troupe of foreign bugs across the United Kingdom to put on some brilliant big bug shows! Charlie Brown Baldness: Under Lingo's hat, is a singular strand of brunette hair. Hybrid Genre: According to theWord of God, Lingo is a ladybird-butterfly hybrid. You don't see that everyday! Cloud Cuckoo Lander: Lingo has some wild (and sometimes unrealistic) ambitions of what the big bug shows could be like. Cunning Linguist: It seems that Lingo knows a whole bunch of languages, being most familiar of the languages of his troupe.

characters.name: Wei
characters.description: Our speedy Chinese red ant, Wèi, also known as Weeeeeee, feels the need for speed, whizzing about the stage on his buggy blades bumping into any and everything in his way. Bubblegum Popping: In the game which the TV show is based off, in the dress-up minigame, Wei can be seen blowing some bubblegum, and it popping. Cool Helmet: He isalwaysseen with his crash helmet. It alsobares the Chinese symbol for insect, "虫" (Chóng). Genki Guy: Wei is a very, very, VERY energetic little bug boy. Shock and Awe: In the Cbeebies website game, Wei is seen having some sort of lightning/electric related powers of some sort. In the TV show, it is never shown, reason is unknown.

characters.name: Jargonaise
characters.description: Just a common house fly from France and never admitting to having any work done (when clearly she’s had loads), Jargonaise is the consummateDrama Queenmaking her grand appearance and being the centre of her attention! Ambiguously Bi: Jargonaise has a habit of blowing kisses to her audience at the end of her performance, and seems to do it to anybody and doesn't care if the crowd has boys or girls in it. Containment Clothing: When she isn't performing, Jargonaise wears this tube-like head piece on her feathers, the reasoning is unknown, but it is most likely to just keep them out of her face. Crowd Pleaser: She loves attention. Disco Dan: Her design takes on a disco theme, having disco balls for the top of her antenna's and pink glittery clothing.

characters.name: Queso
characters.description: Queso is the cheesy Flamenco guitar-playing moth-like Spanish bug. Watch out though when the spotlights shine, he goes a bit funny… Ambiguously Bi: Queso is seen dancing with this Spanish dancer Floozle in his hello song and'Questanets', despite this he and Lingo are seen to have some sort of homoerotic tension between the two. The Casanova: He is seen trying to impress the flamenco bug in his hello song and in'Questanets'. Clownification: Queso peformed as a clown for his Big Bug Show in Season 1 Episode 12 titled "Queso the Clown" Funny Foreigner: He is quite the comedic spanish bug, especially inQueso the Clown

characters.name: Lieb
characters.description: The sweet and athletic tick from Germany. Lovable Jock: Most jocks in media are mean and assholes, but Lieb is a very kind one. Passionate Sports Girl: Lieb is a very athletic girl, not for any personal gain, just for fun. Tomboy and Girly Girl: The Tomboy to Jargonaise's Girly Girl.

characters.name: Blodwen
characters.description: The fluffy caterpillar Blodwen from Wales is the nurturing one of the bunch, always ready andwilling to give a huge warm hugto the rest of our bug family. Aerith and Bob: Blodwen's name has to be the most rare out of all of the cast, it comines two welsh words, those words being:Blodeuyn, which means "flower".Gwen, which can mean "smile", "white", "fair", or "pure".She also happens to be named after the first opera in the welsh language. characters.name: Jaadoo
characters.description: Jaadoo is the resident wobbling tick from Pakistan, forever trying to balance on his tiny homemade unicycle. One-Wheeled Wonder: Jaadoo is always (and by always Imeanalways) seen riding his unicycle.

characters.name: The Bloozles
characters.description: Little Green Men: They're little bugs, that are green, and are likely mostly male.
